results.name: Spreadsheet: closing a dirty window asks Save changes? — MODAL: Delete, typing, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+S, Alt+F4, Meta+W, a script focusing the grid and a raw click on a cell never reach the workbook; Tab stays inside; Escape cancels; Save writes the file and closes

Writer: typing writes a recovery draft (python-docx reads its bytes; no version snapshots); Close → Don't save keeps it; reopening offers Restore; Restore brings the text back unsaved; Save writes it and deletes the draft
leaving the page with unsaved work raises the browser's beforeunload prompt (dismiss = stay); a page with nothing unsaved closes without one
Editor: the draft lands INSIDE /System/Recovery (TT68 wrote /System/Recovery_… beside it); Don't save keeps it; reopening offers it; Discard deletes it and leaves the file as it was
Editor: Ctrl+S saves only from inside its own window — not under the Save dialog, not with focus outside the window (TT68's listener saved from anywhere)
Spreadsheet: a draft whose file changed since is offered flagged as changed-since; Restore brings the drafted edit back as unsaved (the newer file is not overwritten until Save)
